input.$description: Corner radius of the text fields: input, textarea, and select (BR-10). TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Outline stroke width of the text fields (BR-10, BR-13). TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

bg.$description: Fill of the text fields: the pure black page (BR-03). A field is separated from the page by its outline (C-05).

fg.$description: Text typed into a field. TBD-04: the body text color is not decided; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text of a field. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

border.$description: Outline color of a field at rest. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

borderHover.$description: Outline color of a field while hovered: brand pink (BR-01).

border.$description: Outline color of a field in the error state. TBD-07: feedback colors are not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

fg.$description: Color of the error text under a field. TBD-07: feedback colors are not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

color.$description: Focus ring color of the text fields (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of the text fields (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between a field and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the text fields (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
